title: Chapter 249: Late-Night Taxi Driver
html:
The park would begin promoting the Haunted House the following day, and Chen Ge could not waste the opportunity. Director Luo had placed all his hopes upon him; naturally, Chen Ge did not want to disappoint him.

After the expansion tonight, Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy should be unlocked. Having a new two-star scenario will be beneficial for the plan tomorrow.

The second expansion might even get him a new unique construct, and Chen Ge was anticipating it.

The Midnight Ticket Counter can help me attract special visitors. I wonder, what will the use of the new construct be?

He returned to work after lunch. Around three in the afternoon, the compact cassette player he had ordered finally arrived, allowing him to summon Xu Yin whenever necessary.

It still feels weird bringing a recorder on my missions, but that is more natural than bringing a large tape recorder.

The Haunted House closed at 6:30 p.m., though increasing crowds had gradually pushed the final tours later. Seeing the sky darken, Chen Ge abandoned his plan to visit the Linjiang New Schistosomiasis Control Station. It lay far from New Century Park, and he did not want to act rashly before confirming No. 10’s identity.

After cleaning, Chen Ge entered the underground scenarios.

Tian Teng Medical School excels at interactivity and replayability. My Haunted House could improve in that area. More exploration and mystery would draw visitors deeper into each scenario.

Chen Ge worked inside the Haunted House until ten that night.

Xu Wan handles Minghun, while I manage Mu Yang High School and the Third Sick Hall underground. Murder by Midnight still needs someone to play the killer.Chen Ge had few people he could trust. Uncle Xu was too old to chase visitors through the attraction and far too kind to portray a murderer. Gu Feiyu was a much better fit.

The kid is not experienced, but Murder by Midnight has Xiaoxiao’s family watching over him, so he should be fine.

His only concern was that Xiaoxiao’s family might frighten Gu Feiyu.Reliable human employees are so difficult to find. My ghost workers are much more dependable.

He returned to the staff breakroom to look over the information in his phone. The pictures that Captain Yan had sent him unsettled Chen Ge.

The Ghost Stories Society has me in its sights. If its members infiltrate the crowds and cause trouble at a critical moment, Director Luo’s campaign will be ruined. I need to deal with them quickly.

The Third Sick Hall’s patients were capable of anything. If they blended into the crowds, identifying them would be nearly impossible. The only reliable prevention was capturing them beforehand.

No. 12 is the DJ for Ghost Talk, and No. 5 is the show’s producer. Should I start with them?

Chen Ge searched for Ghost Talk on his phone. One promotional notice caught his attention. The program normally began at midnight, but that evening it had been moved forward an hour. The stated reason was that Lychee, having taken the previous night off, wished to spend an extra hour with her listeners.

That does sound like a valid reason.

The episode listing put him on alert. All five stories scheduled for the first hour involved taxi drivers.

Is it a taxi driver special today?

Why schedule every one before midnight? The arrangement looked deliberate. Chen Ge tuned in and lay on his bed to listen.

At 10:55 p.m., the woman’s mellifluous voice came through the speaker.

“We meet in the night but part before morning. However, our parting is to prepare for a later reunion. Good evening, I’m your late night DJ, Lychee.”

Her voice was naturally pleasant. She required no special technique; its sound alone was soothing.

Such a waste of a beautiful voice.Chen Ge continued to listen.

“Jiujiang is an ancient city, and many historic buildings remain in its old quarter. One of the area’s most famous places is Huai Hua Street. Its fame, however, comes not from its history but from a series of incidents that occurred there. Despite the name, not a single huai flower tree grows on the street. Even Jiujiang’s elders do not know how it received that name.”

The woman continued in a style difficult to imitate. She began gently, weaving a net around her listeners. Once they were thoroughly entangled, she jerked it tight and unleashed every scare at once.

Lychee’s first story happened at Huai Hua Street. A taxi driver picked up a customer at Huai Hua Street at midnight. The customer said that she had left something behind and wished for him to help her retrieve it.

She provided a vague address, and the driver set off. Yet each time he reached the destination she named, the passenger insisted he had gone to the wrong place. Just as his patience neared its limit, she offered one final address: the bus stop beside the crematorium.

The ending was startling. The passenger found what she had lost: her soul entered the driver’s body and departed, while his was sealed inside the funerary urn she had been seeking.

The story is passable, mainly because it was Lychee who told the story. She told it like it was a real story.

Then a thought occurred to Chen Ge. Could Lychee’s story be true?

After all, Huai Hua Street really did exist.

Could she have heard her story from other members of the Ghost Stories Society?

Lychee started her second story. It also happened at Huai Hua Street, and the main character was still a late-night taxi driver.

“Something is wrong.” Captain Yan had told him that every case connected to the Ghost Stories Society occurred on a Wednesday. The day held special significance for them.

“Ghost Talk has been moved earlier by one hour today, so before midnight, today is still Wednesday. Are they planning to do something tonight?”

Lychee’s second story deepened Chen Ge’s suspicion. It ended in the same way: a ghost regained life by sacrificing innocent people.

“Huai Hua Street, taxi driver…” Chen Ge thought about it and grabbed his jacket. “Human lives are on the line. I should go take a look.”

He packed the cassette player, tape, and ballpoint pen, then rushed from the staff break room. Remembering his previous experience, he stopped at the Props Room and added Doctor Skull-cracker’s hammer to the bag.
